errors.subscriptionPlanClientDrift: The subscription's client does not match the plan's client scope. Detach or re-scope the plan before recognizing revenue.
errors.noLinesToInvoice: Cannot create an invoice with no line items. Add a price plan with at least one product, or override at least one line.

form.referenceInfo: Unique identifier for this revenue record. Used on invoices and receipts.
form.dateInfo: The date the revenue is recognised or the transaction took place.
form.customerInfo: The client this revenue record is billed to.
form.locationInfo: The branch or location where this revenue was generated.
form.subscriptionInfo: Link to an existing subscription to pre-fill line items and apply the agreed pricing.
form.currencyInfo: Currency used for all amounts on this record.
form.notesInfo: Internal remarks — shown on detail pages but not on customer-facing documents.
